references.text: God gives wisdom in the heart to craftsmen to make the priestly garments for Aaron, the same theme of God-given wisdom for holy work.
The Lord puts wisdom in the heart of all who are skilled, to carry out the work on the tabernacle.
The fulfillment of the call in 35:10, where Bezalel, Oholiab, and all the wise men begin the work that the Lord has commanded.
The women who were wise in heart spun yarn and goat hair for the tabernacle, parallel to the wise men who were called.
The Lord calls Bezalel and fills him with God's Spirit, wisdom, and understanding to carry out all skilled work.
Solomon asks for a wise heart to judge the people, using the same expression 'wise in heart' for a God-given task.
Whoever is wise in heart accepts instruction, a proverb linking wisdom to obedience to God's commands.
The gifts of the Spirit are given to different people for service in Christ's body, parallel to how God equips his people with various abilities.
